claim: Improved electron detectors will allow the structures of macromolecules to be determined from tens of thousands of single-particle cryo-EM images.
source_text: Improved electron detectors and image-processing techniques will allow the structures of macromolecules to be determined from tens of thousands of single-particle cryo-EM images, rather than the hundreds of thousands needed previously.
